description.value:
When the chemist creates a bomb, he can infuse it with cytillesh extract. Cytillesh bombs deal 1d4 points of damage, plus 1d4 points of damage for every 3 chemist levels after 1st, instead of 1d6. Creatures that take a direct hit from a cytillesh bomb are sickened for 1 round per chemist level unless they succeed at Fortitude saves. If a creature is rendered unconscious from this bomb or any other attack before it is able to remove the sickened condition, the victim loses all memory from the last hour and cannot form new memories for 8 hours. The lost and prevented memories might return later as dreams, and can be restored with a restora spell.

* This discovery modifies bombs. Discoveries marked with an asterisk do not stack; only one such discovery can be applied to an individual bomb.
